archive.format: sorted little-endian C-contiguous NPY v1.0, ZIP deflate9, epoch1980, Unix0600, no extra/comment

generator.reproducibility: --check-reproducible requires exact array hashes, archive bytes and manifest identity; backend machine/python/zlib execution provenance is compared and reported separately

layouts.coordinates.*.position_ids: 3,1,L (T,H,W); physical spans exclude delimiters, official not small-vocab IDs
layouts.coordinates.mrope.*: target rotary64/head256 sections[11,11,10], from two_images; query/key layout B,H,L,D
layouts.metadata.* and template.*: raw UTF-8 bytes as uint8, never object/pickle arrays
layouts.text.*.conv_state: B,2*K_heads*K_dim+V_heads*V_dim,kernel; oldest to newest including current token
layouts.text.*.recurrent_state: B,V_heads,K_dim,V_dim, HF grouped order; tinygrad transposes last two and permutes heads
layouts.text.*.step.i.*: Snapshot after chunk i; chunk_lengths gives physical consumption
layouts.text.full.attn_q_gate: B,L,heads*(2*head_dim); Q then gate WITHIN each head, sigmoid output gate
layouts.text.weights.*: Official Qwen3_5ForCausalLM.state_dict keys (model.* and lm_head.weight); no GGUF conversion
layouts.vision.weights.*: Official Qwen3_5VisionModel.state_dict keys; no model.visual prefix

amd_quantized.scope: Hardware/quantization-specific acceptance must be declared before AMD evaluation

hf_fp32_algebra.scope: Official HF eager+Torch fallback FP32; tolerances predeclared, not fitted to native errors

lowered_fp32_weights.scope: Existing codegen/late/coalesce.py pm_simplify_add_image removes fused float->half->float roundtrips: FP32-weight GDN input stays FP32. Materialized GDN output and KV remain FP16. Separate HF cast-only oracle; compiler behavior is explicitly probed in native tests. Not quantized, BF16, FP16-weight or hardware acceptance.

native_cast.scope: Official HF eager/F32 weights with explicit FP16-roundtrip GDN input and gated norm output; FP16 post-RoPE K/V cache, FP32 reads/arithmetic/conv/recurrent state. No algebra/layout patches. text.native_cast.* only; the original text.* HF algebra arrays remain unchanged.

processor_contract.exif: not exercised: synthetic RGB has no EXIF; policy belongs to B1
processor_contract.limits: Oracle and later native use min65536/max262144 areas
processor_contract.patch_order: image, t, merged_row, merged_col, intra_row, intra_col
processor_contract.small_vision: do_resize=False only for isolated 64x96/96x64 tower, not production preprocessing

rng: NumPy PCG64 default_rng, sorted named_parameters; see initialize_weights; Torch seed fixes constructors only

source.weights: Synthetic random weights only; no checkpoint tensors downloaded.

template.scope: Pinned metadata IDs and official Jinja renderer; full BPE vocabulary/GGUF tokenizer audit deferred to A2/E.
